record.reason: DAVSS distills a transformer audio-visual classifier into a 14M-parameter SSM; the primary text reports faster inference (up to about 2x at a larger patch size) while retaining or improving AudioSet classification results. This is an audio-visual classifier rather than a generative LLM, so transfer to LLM inference is unresolved.
record.title: DAVSS: Distilled Audio-Visual State Space Models
